tasks.title: Implement create[Entity] Server Action
tasks.description: Implements the create[Entity] Server Action in the features/[domain]/actions directory. Validates input with Zod, calls the DAL to persist, and records an audit_log entry.
tasks.context_summary: This Server Action is the primary mutation entry point for creating [entity] records. It must validate input using the Create[Entity]Schema Zod schema, call the DAL function create[Entity]Record, and write an audit_log entry with event type '[entity].created'. The action runs in an authenticated context — check session via NextAuth before processing.
function_signatures: export async function create[Entity](input: Create[Entity]Input): Promise<ActionResult<[Entity]>>
acceptance_criteria: Function validates input using Create[Entity]Schema Zod schema
Function returns the created entity on success
Function throws ZodError with field-level details on invalid input
Function records audit_log entry with event type '[entity].created'
Function returns error object (not throws) for business rule violations
Unauthenticated calls return unauthorized error — no data written

mock_requirements: Prisma client (mock DAL layer for unit tests)
test_requirements.test_notes: Unit test with mocked DAL. Integration test against real test database. Test invalid input, valid input, and unauthenticated scenarios.

security_requirements.security_notes: Validate session with NextAuth getServerSession. Use Create[Entity]Schema for all user input. Write audit_log before returning success.
